# Sunrise Clinic: patient FAQ and price list

## Timings
The clinic is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 8pm. On Sunday we are open from 9am to 1pm only. We are closed on national holidays.

## Location and parking
Sunrise Clinic is at 12 MG Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, next to the metro station. Free parking for patients is available in the basement.

## Consultation fees
General physician consultation fee is Rs 500. Specialist consultation fee is Rs 900. A follow-up visit within 7 days costs Rs 200.

## Tests and packages
A complete blood count (CBC) test costs Rs 350. The full body health checkup package costs Rs 2,499 and includes 60 tests. Thyroid profile costs Rs 600. Report delivery takes 24 hours by WhatsApp.

## Appointments
To book an appointment, share your name, preferred date and time. Walk-ins are welcome but appointments get priority. Online video consultation is available on weekdays from 2pm to 5pm.

## Payments
We accept UPI, cards and cash. Insurance cashless claims are accepted for Star Health and HDFC Ergo.

## Doctors
Dr. Mehta (general physician) is available Monday to Friday. Dr. Rao (dermatologist) visits on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.

## Cancellation
You can cancel or reschedule an appointment up to 2 hours before the slot at no charge.
